newsitem.title: USA: Marvel stockholder group opposes Toy Biz.
newsitem.headline: Marvel stockholder group opposes Toy Biz.

text.p: A committee representing stockholders in Marvel Entertainment Group Inc said Tuesday it opposed a reorganization plan developed by Marvel and Toy Biz Inc.
The committee said it had repeatedly attempted to consult with Marvel regarding the plan.
It said Marvel had refused to discuss any proposed reorganization plan with the committee and had resisted providing the committee's representatives with access to the company.
The committee said it could not support the new plan and would explore all available alternatives.

Marvel said yesterday that Toy Biz Inc had tentatively agreed to acquire Marvel's publishing and licensing businesses in a reorganization that would provide Marvel's secured lenders cash, equity in a new company, and all the stock of Marvel's Fleer/SkyBox and Panini subsidiaries.
